name: MrScraper
verdict: No OAuth and no customer connection: you call the scraping API with your own token on a paid plan. A customer who wants their own account pastes their token; same day.
needGuide: No — just keep your own API token server-side, and collect a customer's only if they bring their own.

auth.detail: API token sent in the x-api-token header; marketplace endpoints use Authorization: Bearer <token> (RFC 6750). Base URL in the docs examples is https://api.app.mrscraper.com/api/v1/. No OAuth documented. An official MCP server exists (source: github.com/mrscraper-com/mrscraper-mcp).

approval.gate: No approval gate documented. You need a subscription or token plan with enough usage. Customers do not connect accounts; your app calls the scraping API with your own token, or customers paste their own token.

scopes.why: No scopes documented; a token has the account's full API access.
scopes.summary: No scopes documented; a token has the account's full API access.

cost: Subscription with token-based usage (see Token Plan and Billing pages); free trial terms not confirmed
prerequisites: Account and owner: Whoever owns the MrScraper account creates the token; use a company-owned account.
Where you register: Sign in at app.mrscraper.com and create an API token (the exact dashboard menu was not shown in the docs)
Cost: Subscription with token-based usage (see Token Plan and Billing pages); free trial terms not confirmed

registerAt.path: Sign in at app.mrscraper.com and create an API token (the exact dashboard menu was not shown in the docs)

steps.do: Create a company MrScraper account at app.mrscraper.com
Generate an API token in the dashboard and store it as a server secret
Call the Verify Token endpoint with x-api-token to confirm plan and usage
Rerun an existing scraper via the API as a smoke test and watch token usage
For customer-supplied tokens, add a paste field, validate via Verify Token, and store the token encrypted

roles.team: Whoever owns the MrScraper account creates the token; use a company-owned account.
roles.customer: None. If customers bring their own token, they create it in their own dashboard and paste it.

testing: Use a Verify API Token endpoint (returns subscription account details, usage, limits and billing) to validate keys, then run a small scraper and check usage in the dashboard.

blockers.problem: Token usage varies between runs (see the Token Plan page)
Two header styles (x-api-token versus Bearer for marketplace endpoints)
blockers.fix: Use the right one per endpoint.

blockers.problem: No OAuth, so you cannot offer one-click connect
Scraping targets may have their own ToS

automation.agentCan: Write the client, token validation, retry logic and the MCP configuration, and run test calls.
automation.humanMust: Create the account, choose and pay for a plan, and generate the token in the dashboard.

uncertain: Exact dashboard path for creating tokens, free trial terms, rate limits, plan requirements, and whether the MCP server has a hosted OAuth endpoint.
